hub.title: Your application
hub.subtitle: Complete each step, then submit for review. Our team reads every application personally.
hub.lockedPending: Your application is under review, so it can't be edited right now. We'll let you know as soon as there's news.
hub.rejectedHelp: Update your application, then submit it again.
hub.readyHint: Everything is complete. You can submit.
hub.notReadyHint: Finish the steps above to submit.

sections.profileBody: City, bio, experience and service area
sections.servicesBody: What you offer and what you charge
sections.referencesBody: Two people who can speak to your care

profile.title: About you
profile.headline: Headline
profile.headlineHint: One line, e.g. “Registered vet tech specialising in senior dogs”
profile.bioHint: Your experience, approach and what owners can expect.
profile.postalHint: Used to match you with nearby owners. Owners only ever see the first part.
profile.speciesRequired: Choose at least one kind of animal.

services.title: Services & rates
services.intro: Choose the services you offer and set your rate. Rates are before tax.
services.commissionNote: Our commission is {{percent}} of your rate. You keep the rest.
services.noCity: Choose your city in “About you” first to see the services available.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.intro: Upload the certificates and documents that show your training. Our team verifies each one and issues your badges.
credentials.privacy: Documents are stored privately and seen only by our review team.
credentials.name: Title

references.title: References
references.intro: Add at least two people who can speak to your work with animals. We may contact them.
references.name: Name
references.contactHint: Provide an email or a phone number.

consent.title: Consent
consent.intro: We ask for only what we need to keep owners and pets safe.
consent.backgroundCheck: I consent to {{appName}} arranging a criminal background check and verifying my references and credentials. I understand this information is used only to assess my application.
consent.terms: I confirm the information I've provided is accurate, and I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

errors.application_incomplete_profile: Please complete “About you” first (city, name, bio and postal code).
errors.application_missing_consent: Please give both consents before submitting.
errors.application_needs_credential: Please upload at least one credential.
errors.application_needs_two_references: Please add at least two references.
errors.application_needs_service: Please offer at least one service with a rate.
errors.invalidPostal: Enter a valid postal code, for example {{example}}.
errors.fileTooLarge: That file is too large (10 MB maximum).
errors.contactRequired: Provide an email or a phone number.
errors.locked: Your application is locked while it is being reviewed.
